adjudication.depicted_input: Amino acid sequences and functional descriptions encoded by an LLM into protein embeddings, then passed as node-feature inputs into the Shusi graph module.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop already shows the route inputs and embeddings, but the better crop in the same figure also includes the immediate handoff into the Shusi graph pipeline. That makes the depicted input interface explicit. Under the atlas rules, this shared architecture panel validly supports both pretraining and fine-tuning routes because the same sequence/text-to-embedding input mechanism is shown, and fine-tuning inputs may rely on retained pretraining features.
